entities.name: Tok-Tok
entities.description: Old akki shaman of Kamigawa famous for surviving almost anything; became impervious to fire.

entities.name: Sokenzan Mountains
entities.description: Mountains where Tok-Tok lived at a volcano's mouth.

events.summary: Tok-Tok falls into a volcano's lava, climbs out, and the lava cools around him, making him impervious to fire.
events.quote: He survived the incident and became impervious to fire
